capabilities: Pair with a companion WeChat Mini Program using a pairing code
Pull pending article links on demand from the ribbon or command palette
Convert web articles into Markdown notes with YAML frontmatter
Download article images locally and rewrite links for offline use
Sort imported notes into folders by account or keyword rules, with reusable topic profiles
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a device-sync tool; syncing is manual only and means pulling queued article links into the vault.
extras: The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The service applies a daily sync quota; paid plans or invite codes raise it. On mobile, writing to another local vault is disabled because Node.js file-system APIs are unavailable. Chinese-language documentation is included.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture WeChat articles (or other web pages) as Markdown notes with images stored locally for offline use.

relations.evidence: Pair with the companion WeChat Mini Program by entering a short pairing code.
Built on the Obsidian sample plugin (0BSD, Dynalist Inc.).

requires.name: SyncBridge paid plan (raises the daily sync quota)

summary: Web clipper that pulls article links queued in a WeChat Mini Program and archives them as Markdown notes with locally saved images.
